prompt: Implement the 5-qubit Quantum Fourier Transform as a general-purpose circuit block (it must correctly transform an ARBITRARY input state, not just |00000> — do not build a circuit that only works from a fixed starting state). The transform is specified symbolically instead of with pre-evaluated numbers: for qubit j (0-indexed, j=0..4) apply a Hadamard, then for every qubit k < j apply a controlled-phase gate with angle 2*pi / 2^(j-k+1), control=qubit k, target=qubit j. After all Hadamard/controlled-phase stages, apply the final SWAP-reversal layer (swap qubit i with qubit 4-i, for i=0..1) to match the standard Qiskit QFT ordering convention. No measurement.
